text:
emma: quick heads-up — comet24k int4 on staging shows a repeated-token shadow starting ~18k tokens. Repro: `rwi-bench --model comet24k-int4 --ctx 32768 --prompt-file tests/long_anchor.txt`.

raj: float32 baseline OK?

emma: float32 holds through 32k, int4 starts copying an earlier block (not just off-by-one). Snippet: float: "...returned the expected payload." int4: "...expected payload.expected payload..."

oliver: smells like quant_pack stride or a write order race when packing int4 into lanes. Can you try int8?

bench-bot: quick int8 smoke on ded-2 completed — no shadowing up to 50k, mismatch_rate ~3e-5 vs float.

emma: synthetic loop (append anchor, gen 1) reproduces deterministically at ~18k. KV hex dump shows repeated indices in int4 path.

raj: next steps: run with `--kv_debug=1`, try `rope_table_precision=double`, and repro on another GPU family to rule out kernel quirks.

emma: did kv_debug run and toggled RoPE double — double-precision delays the symptom to ~21k but does not fix it.

sasha: created ticket RED-ML-4821 and tagged @hw-kernels + @infra with logs and dumps. Add a long-anchor canary to CI (40k token synthetic).

emma: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/rwi-runtime/pull/5891 with a reproducer and unit tests; running 50k stress on ded-3 (jid=87458).

oliver: plan: patch quant_pack to enforce atomic stride + defensive fence after KV writes; kernel review needed.

emma: will iterate on PR and follow up with results. thanks all :thumbsup:
